outliers.video_title: 8 Things to Avoid If You Want to Heal Knee Cartilage Without Surgery
outliers.trigger: fear of re-injury / fear of making it worse
outliers.why_it_worked: The title leverages loss aversion by framing common behaviors as threats to healing, making viewers fear they are unknowingly sabotaging their own recovery. The phrase 'Without Surgery' removes the worst-case outcome and makes the promise feel high-stakes but achievable. A numbered list signals specific, actionable information rather than vague advice, which builds trust and justifies the click.
outliers.trend_or_evergreen: evergreen — knee cartilage damage and the desire to avoid surgery are persistent, timeless concerns that exist independent of any news cycle or seasonal trend
outliers.rewritten_title: 8 Things to Avoid If You Want to Heal Your Rotator Cuff Without Surgery
outliers.rewritten_hook: Show a split screen or point directly to camera and say: 'If you're doing any of these 8 things right now, you could be silently re-injuring your rotator cuff every single day — and not even know it.'
